title: GovernanceEventReceptor
description: Identifies the receptor that receives governance events. The ontology reference and accepted event types define the governance contract surface — which ontology instance is listening for which governance signals. Source: ITIP Meta-Governance Ontology; GSM Receptor semantics.

ontologyRef.description: URI reference identifying the governance ontology this receptor listens for (e.g., 'gsmarc://gsm-ontology/gdpr/v1'). Defines WHICH governance domain this port serves. Identity-bound: receptors of the same Definition always listen for the same ontology. Source: ITIP ontology catalogue.
